Growing your lending business should be easier LendFusion is a loan management software built for new and established lenders that have high growth ambitions. Schedule a Discovery Call Affordable pricing. Hassle free setup. Modern, easy-to-use loan management platform 15 years experience helping lenders grow their business • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • Whether you’re reducing manual work, launching new products, or staying ahead of regulations, LendFusion is designed to help you scale without complexity. Backed by Experts With 15+ years in lending, we provide tailored solutions that fit your needs - far beyond a one-size-fits-all loan platform. A Partner in Growth Skip slow customer support teams. Our dedicated experts provide hands-on support to help you streamline operations and scale with confidence. Fully Automated Automate loan origination, underwriting, and collections while maintaining full control. Custom workflows and AI-powered decisioning keep risk in check. Fast Implementation Go live in weeks, not months. Pre-configured solutions and seamless integrations with key financial tools make migration effortless. Join the Network of High-Growth Lenders Using LendFusion • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • End-to-end lending process From customer origination to reporting – LendFusion covers the whole process. Customer origination Online application KYC Loan offer Decision making Automated decision making Credit scoring Verification Data processing Application review Secure document storage Credit management Disbursements Contract generation Signature process Collections and reporting CRM Bank reconciliation Predefined or custom reporting LendFusion: End-to-End Loan Management LendFusion streamlines your entire lending process with a user-friendly platform and powerful third-party integrations. Get advanced automation, seamless workflows, and expert support - at a price that makes growth scalable. Payment solutions Open banking Communication Underwriting Powerful Features to Streamline Your Lending Operations Full Audit Trail for Complete Transparency LendFusion automatically tracks every loan application, transaction, and update, giving you a comprehensive, real-time audit trail. Stay compliant, reduce risk, and gain full visibility over your entire loan book. Automated Loan Approvals LendFusion’s Decision Engine automates application processing based on your risk criteria. Configure approvals, declines, or manual reviews - streamlining your workflow and reducing manual work. No Developers Needed - Easily Customize Loan Products Configure interest rates, repayment terms, and penalty fees in just a few clicks. LendFusion’s intuitive interface gives you full control, eliminating the need for IT resources or custom coding. Seamless Borrower Communication at Every Stage Send personalized loan offers, agreements, and payment reminders via email or SMS. Predefined templates automate outreach, ensuring customers stay informed without adding to your workload. 24/7 Borrower Portal to Reduce Support Requests Give customers instant access to loan details, repayment schedules, and application statuses through a self-service portal - cutting down on emails and freeing up your team’s time. See all features LendFusion made the transition effortless and gave us the scalability and automation we needed to grow without increasing our team size. Not only have they helped us streamline loan tracking and payments, but their support has been integral in allowing us to expand across multiple markets without any operational disruption. Nader AlSalim Founder, Gaia Family In 2017, Marten and I came to LendFusion as a small start up with a loan portfolio size of € 0. Today, we have 200+ employees, a loan portfolio of € 100 million and we're on our way to achieving unicorn status. Planet42’s growth would never have been possible without LendFusion. Read more Eerik Oja CEO, Planet42 Using LendFusion loan management software has been a game-changer for our business! Its user-friendly interface allows us to effortlessly manage our loans, and our admin work has decreased rapidly. We can now spend more time on work that brings in more customers and more sales. Kristjan Tolmats CEO, Evergreen We came to LendFusion with very specific needs in terms of loan management. No other platform could offer us the same level of product, service and experience. LendFusion is not just a product, they are an important partner in the growth of our business. Robin Hyde-Chambers CEO, Funeral Safe Ltd LendFusion automates lending operations, reducing manual work so you can scale faster and focus on growth.
